This '''unidentified [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] rebel''' was recruited to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] new fighting unit, [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]]. He fought with [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] when they were ambushed on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. He survived through the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although it is unconfirmed, It appears quite likely this [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] is in fact [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]]. He wears the same red B-wing pilot uniform that Ted Numb wears in his screen appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']]. Furthermore, in every cutscene in which the unnamed [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] rebel in [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] appears, he seems to be a hand drawn mirror image of the picture of [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] shown on his original [[Topps]] ''Return of the Jedi'' trading card.
